title: 第二十四章青冥血影
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
【推演功法品级：筑基】

    【目前选项：】

    【1.基础剑法】

    【2.白青罡气】

    【3.阴阳合欢功】

    ……

    【筑基等级后，宿主可选择两个已有功法进行融合，推演出新的功法。】

    【同时，可以选择目标功法类型。】

    要是我把两个用的最喜欢用的结合……张守安将白青罡气和化血煞剑拖到了合成栏里。

    下一刻就弹出了提示。

    【请选择推演功法类型】

    【剑法】【身法】【心法】【锻体法】【阵法】【丹术】【拳法】……

    种类之多，张守安根本看不过来。

    他吞了口口水，知道自己目前最缺什么。

    他意念一动，系统自动推演。

    【选择目标：身法】

    【推演中……】

    【功法名称：青冥血影（筑基）（入门）】

    由于这次推演的巨大花费，他此刻又被榨干了，不过在耐心等了几分钟后，他的道行值又到账了。

    他现在是体会到前世那些总裁的生活了，坐着就来钱的感觉，真爽。

    他再次将道行值投入。

    四周场景再次变化，张守安又来到了自己的脑海中。

    这次是一片天际，四周没有一片陆地，幸亏进来的是张守安的灵识，若是本体进来，此刻已经从万里高空摔下，摔成肉泥。

    他现在漂浮在空中，由于掌握不好平衡，原地转了几圈，才稳住身形。

    最后他遥遥望去，就看见远处云间，站立着一道身影，他脚轻踩云间，脚边有青光流淌。

    他瞅了眼张守安，而后脚下一踩，白云凹陷几分，然后化作一团青色流光，消失在云间。

    张守安眨了眨眼，不断在云间搜寻着那人的身影，只不过却是久久无法找到。

    “去哪了？”……他自言了一句，而后就感觉肩上传来一阵轻拍。

    他一转头就看见了那张模糊的脸，但下一秒，张守安就见他脚下的青光化为红光。

    那个身影竟在他面前就消失不见。

    张守安一愣，肩上再次传来轻拍。
content_en:
[Deduction of Kung Fu Level: Foundation Establishment]

[Current options:]

【1.Basic swordsmanship】

【2.Bai Qinggang Qi】

【3. Yin Yang He Huan Gong】

…

[After the foundation level is established, the host can choose two existing skills to fuse and deduce a new skill.】

[At the same time, you can select the target skill type.】

If I combine the two favorites... Zhang Shou'an dragged Bai Qinggang Qi and Blood Transforming Evil Sword into the synthesis column.

A prompt popped up the next moment.

[Please select the type of deduction technique]

[Sword Technique] [Body Technique] [Heart Technique] [Body Training Technique] [Array Technique] [Alchemy Technique] [Fist Technique]...

There are so many types that Zhang Shou'an can't even look at them.

He swallowed, knowing what he lacked most at the moment.

As soon as he thought about it, the system automatically deduced it.

[Select target: Shenfa]

[Deduction in progress...]

[Exercise name: Qingming Blood Shadow (Foundation Building) (Introduction)]

Due to the huge cost of this deduction, he was drained again at this moment, but after waiting patiently for a few minutes, his Tao Xing points were paid again.

He now realizes the life of those CEOs in his previous life. It feels so good to make money just by sitting.

He invested his Tao Xing value again.

The surrounding scene changed again, and Zhang Shouan came to his mind again.

This time it was a vast expanse of sky with no land around it. Fortunately, it was Zhang Shou'an's spiritual consciousness that came in. If his true form had come in, he would have fallen from a height of thousands of miles and turned into a pulp.

He was now floating in the air. Due to his poor balance, he spun around in circles several times before he stabilized his body.

Finally, he looked far away and saw a figure standing among the clouds in the distance. He stepped lightly on the clouds, and there was green light flowing around his feet.

He glanced at Zhang Shou'an, then stepped on it. The white clouds dented a bit, then turned into a ball of cyan light and disappeared among the clouds.

Zhang Shou'an blinked and kept searching for the man's figure in the clouds, but he couldn't find it for a long time.

"Where have you gone?"... He said to himself, and then he felt a tap on his shoulder.

As soon as he turned his head, he saw the blurry face, but the next second, Zhang Shouan saw the green light under his feet turn into red light.

The figure actually disappeared in front of him.

Zhang Shou'an was stunned for a moment, and then there was another tap on his shoulder.
